messages.subject: UAE Investments | Operating-side leadership across government, industry and sustainability
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Karmastaji,

As a communications contact for Mubadala's UAE Investments platform, I would appreciate your placing this confidential executive note before Dr. Bakheet Al Katheeri, Chief Executive Officer, UAE Investments.

Mubadala's UAE Investments platform is distinctive because its mandate is not limited to deploying capital. It builds national champions, develops industrial clusters and works with global partners across sectors where government alignment, institutional relationships and operating execution directly influence value creation.

As those platforms grow, I see a recurring need between investment strategy and portfolio execution: senior country-facing leadership that can connect government, regulators, ESG commitments, local participation, stakeholder risk and executive priorities. This is especially relevant across energy, metals and infrastructure businesses operating in complex or emerging markets.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My work combines senior government and regulator engagement, ESG and social performance, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships, compliance coordination and executive advisory inside a capital-intensive mining operation. I routinely convert external commitments into accountable action across operations, environment, HSE, legal, finance, HR, procurement and technical teams.

I would welcome a conversation about whether this operator-side profile could add value within UAE Investments or across portfolio companies requiring country leadership, government and institutional relations, strategic partnerships or responsible-business execution. My attached CV is tailored to that portfolio-level contribution.

Kind regards,

Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
